model: Gemini 3.8 Flash High (serving identity hidden/unverified per contract)

environment.database: Owned disposable loopback cluster (port 54345); random per-test databases

assertions: POST /api/internal/tasks/tick and GET /api/internal/tasks/status are registered only when BS_RUNTIME=hosted
Operational routes are omitted from OpenAPI schema (include_in_schema=False) and return 404 in BS_RUNTIME=local mode

Zero-database cold-start authentication: unauthenticated, malformed, duplicate header, cookie-only, or invalid bearer token requests reject with generic 401 UNAUTHORIZED before opening any PostgreSQL connection or touching driver code (verified with psycopg.connect probe)
Unset or unconfigured BS_TASK_TICK_TOKEN rejects operational requests with generic 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE before opening any database connection
BS_TASK_TICK_TOKEN is validated as 32..256 ASCII URL-safe characters [A-Za-z0-9_-], preserved without trimming, and redacted from logs, repr, and error messages
Factory initialization (create_app) executes zero database I/O, enabling instant cold starts without network trips

Standard business routes enforce schema readiness at request-time via synchronous FastAPI dependency (require_hosted_schema) offloaded to threadpool, returning generic 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on unmigrated (version 0) or future schemas
Health endpoint (/api/health) remains pure DB-free liveness probe returning HTTP 200 regardless of database readiness
Operational endpoints invoke HostedSchedulerService.check_schema() with tight scheduler SQL limits (2s connect / 500ms statement / 250ms lock) and reject unmigrated schemas with generic 503
Operational endpoints strictly disregard all request body and query parameters; candidate limit (100), processing budget (20s), and lease duration (60s) cannot be overridden
POST /api/internal/tasks/tick maps outcome success/partial to 200 OK, busy/stale_lease to 409 Conflict, and failed/error/evidence-write-failure to 503 Service Unavailable
Tick response payload contains outcome, capacity_limited, and aggregate counts; internal run_id and driver error details are strictly omitted
GET /api/internal/tasks/status is strictly read-only: returns current status dictionary without running tasks or mutating state, and returns 503 on database read error
All operational responses return Cache-Control: no-store header

Inactive GitHub Actions workflow example created at docs/workflows/hosted-tick.yml.example with 15-minute offset schedule (7,22,37,52 * * * *), workflow_dispatch, empty permissions ({}), concurrency serialization, BS_SCHEDULER_ENABLED == 'true' gate, curl connect timeout 10s / max-time 55s, no retries, no redirect following, no response-body logging, and explicit 2xx verification
limits: Locally verified scheduler HTTP packaging against disposable local PostgreSQL cluster
Live hosting deployment (Neon PostgreSQL, Vercel frontend), live GitHub Actions schedule activation, shared inference admission, and video gates remain deferred per contract
Zero model inference calls executed ($0 cloud spend)
